audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Renekton Levels 3, 4-5, first item and 2+ items. The packet chart says Skill, Teemo, Skill, Teemo — and the page's own prose agrees with the packet, not the chart ('you cannot force a trade without seeing Blinding Dart go down', 'he kites back immediately', 'the window is narrow', 'a 1v1 and splitpush nightmare you cannot match'). Level 6 was given to Teemo while whys[4] calls it 'your only window to solo-kill him'.
audit.why: Move Quick keeps him outside a 450-unit dash, so mid-lane stages belong to Teemo; Dominus at 6 is the one stage where Renekton's stats beat the kite. The 48.37% win rate over 1319 games fits a lane Renekton is losing outside that window.
audit.corrected: Level 3 to Skill (5/10), Levels 4-5 to Teemo (3/10), Level 6 to Renekton (7/10), first item to Skill (5/10), 2+ items to Teemo (3/10) — both layers, one atomic group.

audit.why: Level 1, level 6 Dominus, first item, and his 2-item on-hit build — four spikes present. The mirror flags that this matchup's spike 'when' labels are out of chronological order, which is a structural issue outside the length band.
audit.corrected: No structural change; the mirror's note about ordering stands.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page contradicts itself about the single most important interaction. breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d correctly say the blind hits autos 'not your W or Q', but the whole content layer says the opposite: whys[0] 'negates your empowered W hits', early 'cancels your empowered W's extra hits', spikes[0] 'shuts down your autos and empowered W', wants.foe[0] 'cancel your empowered W and Q sustain'. Blinding Dart blinds basic attacks; Ruthless Predator's slashes and Cull the Meek are ability damage and land through it.
audit.why: A player reading the content layer will refuse to fight while blinded — abandoning the exact combo that still works. What the blind actually costs you is your autos and the W's auto-reset, which is the mirror's own finding from the other side.
audit.corrected: Blind restated as attacks-only in whys[0], spikes[0].text, early, dontsFull[0].d, report[5].t, breakdown.cooldowns and wants.foe[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Blinding Dart' with no number anywhere.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is a flat 7s at every rank and Move Quick 14s — against your E at 16s rank 1 that is why he resets the gap first.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and phases[3].why.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Teemo must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online, but Move Quick holds him outside E range — you need Blinding Dart spent, not just a wave to hide behind.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Blinding Dart's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: He kites out after every dart — Blinding Dart is 7s flat and your E is 11.5s at rank 4, so he resets the gap faster than you.

edits.before: Dominus stats turn even fights into wins before 25 minutes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Teemo's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Dominus HP eats the poison ticks and the Fury ramp gives two empowered Ws — this is the solo-kill window, so take it at 6.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Teemo carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in, on-hit poison and a shroomed side lane beat you 1v1 — carry threat 7/10, so flank fights instead of splitting.

edits.before: - Teemo Blinding Dart: matchup-defining — Blinds autos — not your W or Q. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Teemo Blinding Dart: 7s flat, and it blinds basic attacks only — your W slashes and Q land through it. - Move Quick: 14s sprint, which is how he leaves your E range. - Dominus: 120s, the level-6 kill window.

edits.before: Blinds autos — not your W or Q. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Blinds autos only — not W or Q. It is 7s: step in once it is spent.

edits.before: That is Teemo's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: The blind stops autos only — keep casting W and Q, they are spell damage.

edits.before: Track Teemo's Blinding Dart: Blinds autos — not your W or Q. When it is down — W-stun + Q him.
edits.after: Blinding Dart is 7s and blinds basic attacks only — W and Q are spell damage and land through it.

edits.before: Teemo's Blinding Dart (Q) negates your empowered W hits and Cull the Meek autos from the very first minion wave — no E means no gap close, so he pokes for free.
edits.after: Blinding Dart blinds your basic attacks — the W slashes and Cull the Meek still land — but with no E to close he simply steps back and pokes you for free.

edits.before: Teemo's Blinding Dart (Q) shuts down your autos and empowered W from the very first wave — he wins any extended auto trade before you have E.
edits.after: Blinding Dart shuts off your autos — not your W or Q, which are spell damage — but with no E at level 1 he wins the auto trade regardless.

edits.before: Level 1 is his — Teemo's Blinding Dart (Q) cancels your empowered W's extra hits and shuts off your Q heal autos, so never walk into his auto range to fish for a trade you cannot complete. Hug the tower side, last-hit with the outer tip of Cull the Meek, and deny him free poke by freezing near your tower. At level 2 you get E, but only dash in if you watched Blinding Dart land on a minion or heard it go out — otherwise he blinds your combo mid-flight and you take a full poison tick for nothing.
edits.after: Level 1 is his — Blinding Dart is 7s and blinds your basic attacks, so your autos and the W auto-reset are gone while it is on you, though the W slashes and Cull the Meek still land as spell damage. Hug the tower side, last-hit with the outer tip of Q, and deny him free poke by freezing near your tower. At level 2 you get E, but only dash in once you have seen the dart spent — otherwise he blinds the autos that bracket your stun and walks out on Move Quick.

edits.before: Land Blinding Dart (Q) on your E approach to cancel your empowered W and Q sustain simultaneously
edits.after: Land Blinding Dart as you close so your autos and the W reset are wasted while he walks away

notes: This page argued with itself: the full layer said the blind hits autos 'not your W or Q', and the content layer said four separate times that it cancels the empowered W and Q. Riot's text is unambiguous that Blinding Dart blinds basic attacks, and Ruthless Predator's slashes are ability damage — the content layer is now aligned with the full layer and with the mirror's finding about the W auto-reset. Five chart rows were moved onto the packet chart; the mirror teemo__renekton was audited first, so if it kept the old rows, mirror-fix will reconcile. The mirror also flags that spikes[] 'when' labels here are out of chronological order (Lvl 1, Lvl 6, 1st item, Lvls 4-5) — still unfixed, since correcting it needs a label swap outside the length band.
